name: action-parity
description: Open standard and validator for one action across GUI, CLI, MCP, automation, and AI.

scripts.check: npm test && npm run test:rust && npm run validate && npm run check:generated && npm run check:agent-skills && npm run check:links
scripts.validate: node bin/action-parity.mjs validate examples/minimal/action-parity.json && node bin/action-parity.mjs validate examples/u-king/action-parity.json && node bin/action-parity.mjs validate examples/node-registry/generated/action-parity.json
scripts.test: node --test test/cli.test.mjs test/validator.test.mjs test/verifier.test.mjs test/project.test.mjs test/generator.test.mjs test/typescript.test.mjs test/doctor.test.mjs test/sdk-core.test.mjs test/sdk-surfaces.test.mjs
